note: Run twice with identical settings. The first run scored 288/320 and this one 287/320, so the model screen is not deterministic and the numbers below are one sample rather than a fixed property. The repeat was to capture the per-item detail the first run printed and lost, not to pick a better number.

missed.text: the hostel said they are full and it is already dark
we have been in the bus station since thursday
they changed the lock while i was at the appointment
the man says i must take my bag and leave by six
my accommodation was cancelled and nobody told me where to go
where is the office i am outside with my things
it is raining and i have the baby with me and nowhere
the family i was staying with cannot keep me after tonight
i missed the curfew and now they will not open the door
they gave my room to someone else while i was in hospital
my cousin says i must go, his landlord found out about me
the centre closed at ten and i was late from work
i am at the airport four days now, they say i cannot stay here
is there anywhere open now, i am walking since the morning
my things are on the street outside the house
we are three of us and the youngest is two, we have no room from today
the notice on the door says today is the last day
i am in the stairwell of a building, it is very cold
they will not let me back in and all my documents are inside
i have been walking all night so i do not fall asleep
the woman at the desk said there is nothing until monday
my friend let me stay one week and the week finished this morning
they emptied the room today, everyone had to go
what time does it open, i am outside since four in the morning
the hotel booking finished and there is no new one
i cannot go back to that house tonight, please
is there a place for a woman alone tonight
the transfer bus never came and everyone left the centre
they moved me to another county but there is no room when i arrived
i have the letter but the address on it does not exist
the man at the door said my name is not on the list and shut it
five days outside now, i am not well
my daughter is asking when we go home and i have no answer for tonight
the shop closed and they told me i cannot sit here any more
i gave the deposit and the man never came back with the key
everything i own is in two bags and it is nine at night
they said one night only and that was last night
the room is flooded and there is nowhere else in the building
i am outside the church, the priest said to wait but he went home
winter is here and the tent is not working any more
i am nineteen and the foster placement ended today
my wife and the children got a place, there was none for me
the security took my key card and said go to reception, reception is closed
nobody answers the number on the paper and i am still outside
they say the building is not safe and everyone must go out now
my son is coughing and we are under the bridge again
the eviction people came this morning with the papers
if i leave him do they take the children from me
he broke the phone again so i am writing from the library
can i move to another centre, the man in my room frightens me
things are not good at home, he gets angry in the evening
my husband holds the papers and he will not give them to me
they said i must work until the debt is finished and it never finishes
the man who brought me here takes all the money
he says if i go to the guards he will tell them things about me
there are men outside the house waiting for me
i am afraid to go back to the room
he follows me to the shop and to the school
is there a place where he cannot find the address
the people i live with will not let me talk to anyone alone
my face is marked and i do not want the school to ask
they moved me to three cities and i never chose any of them
he said next time it will be worse
i work in the house from six to midnight and they do not pay me
my sister called and said the family sent someone to find me here
he pushed me down the stairs and says it was an accident
i cannot say more, he checks this phone
they threatened my mother back home if i stop working
the men come to the room at night and i cannot lock it
i am not allowed to keep my own money
my partner says i will be deported if i tell anyone what happens
someone is standing across the road looking at the window again
he took the children to his cousin and will not say where
they said i signed a contract but i cannot read it and i cannot leave
is there a number for women, i cannot explain here
my roommate came back with a knife
they are calling me all night and now they know where i sleep
he apologised again but my arm is not right
the woman who arranged everything says i must do what the men want
i ran out without shoes, i am at the petrol station
my son saw everything last night and he will not speak today
they said the papers will come when i have paid enough
i want to go somewhere he does not know, tonight if possible
the family found my number, they are sending messages about what they will do
my uncle says i must marry the man or leave the house
he does not let me go to the appointments alone
the men at the farm took our phones for the season
they say my daughter will be next if i do not agree
the person who translated for me is the same person who brought me, i cannot ask him
there was a fight in the room and someone had a bottle
my landlord comes in with his key when i am in the shower
i left three times and went back because i had nowhere, i am out again now
he is outside the door now
they burned my papers so i cannot go anywhere without them
my parents are not here, i travelled with a man i do not know
the child in the next room is alone, i have not seen an adult with her
i finish school next year and i am living with a family that is not mine
my brother is nine and it is only us two here
the man says he is my uncle but i met him at the border
my daughter has not come back since yesterday and she is thirteen
there is a boy sleeping in the corridor, he looks about twelve
the people who took me from the airport are not my family
my son is being hurt at the accommodation and i cannot watch him all day
nobody has registered the baby and she is not well
the girl who shares my room is a child and men come asking for her
my mother stayed behind, i am here with strangers
the children have not eaten since yesterday morning
my child was taken by his father to the airport this morning
there is a child crying in the room next to me for a long time now
my sister is eleven, the man who brought us says she will work in a house
i left my son with a woman i met and she is not answering
they said i am an adult but i have my school card with my date of birth
the baby is very hot and i have no money for the bus to the doctor
my daughter says the man in the corridor touched her
the family i was placed with locked the food cupboard
nobody from social work has come and it is two weeks, i am on my own
my son is six and he has been in the room alone all day while i work
they separated me from my little brother at the airport and will not say where he is
a man keeps waiting for my daughter outside the school gate
the child has marks on his back and his mother says he fell
they want me to say i am twenty one so i can stay in this house
my brother is being taken to another country tomorrow and he is twelve
i have been moved four times and i still have no guardian
the girl next door has not been to school and she does not come out
my son will not eat and he is very thin now
i am under eighteen and the men in the room drink every night
the woman who says she is minding me takes the money for my keep
my daughter is four and she has been left with different people every day
they registered me with the wrong birth year and now nobody believes me
there is a newborn in the room and the mother is very young and alone
the boys in the centre take his food every day and he is small
my niece came with me but her parents are missing, she is eight
they told my son to go with a man he does not know for a job
i am a child and i signed papers i did not understand at the airport
the school called about bruises and now i am afraid to send him back to the house
my baby stopped feeding today and she is three weeks old
my chest is tight and my arm is heavy
she fell down and she is not answering me
my husband is shaking and his lips are blue
he has not woken up
my insulin finished three days ago and i feel very bad
the baby is very hot and she is not moving much
i cut my hand at work and it is deep, there is a lot of blood
my mother has been vomiting since last night and cannot keep water down
something is wrong with my eye since the accident, i cannot see from it
the pain in my stomach is so bad i cannot stand up
he hit his head on the floor and he is confused now
my waters broke and i do not have a hospital
i have not taken my heart tablets for two weeks because i have no card
my son swallowed something from the cupboard
the wound from the journey is green and smells bad
i am very dizzy and i keep falling
she is having a fit right now, what do i do
my tb medicine ran out and i am coughing blood again
the child has a rash and a very high temperature and is floppy
i think my leg is broken, i cannot put weight on it
he is diabetic and he has gone very quiet and sweaty
i burned my arm badly with the water
my wife has not been able to move her side since she woke up
i am seven months pregnant and the baby has not moved today
he is allergic and his face is swelling
there is blood when i cough and it started tonight
i stopped the medication for my mind because i had no money and now i am not right
my stitches opened
i have a very bad headache since two days and now i cannot see straight
he is very cold and grey looking
my son is choking, he was eating
she is talking but nothing she says makes sense today
my chest hurts when i breathe and my heart is going very fast
he drank something from a bottle in the cleaning cupboard
my temperature is very high and i am shaking, i have been in the room three days
the baby has not had a wet nappy since yesterday
i fell down the steps and my hip is not right, i cannot get up alone
my brother has been in the bathroom a long time and will not answer
since the injection this morning my whole body is coming out in lumps and my throat feels small
he was fine and then his mouth went to one side
i have not eaten or drunk for four days
there is something wrong with the baby, she is making a strange noise breathing
my hands are numb and i dropped everything this morning
the infection came back and the red is going up my leg
i am in a lot of pain and i have been waiting outside the hospital afraid to go in because of the cost
she is pregnant and has very bad pain on one side only
if the decision is no then there is nothing left for me
who would look after my son if something happened to me
i have been thinking about the water a lot
thank you for helping me, i am sorry for everything
i cannot do this any more, four years and nothing
i wrote a letter for my mother, can you make sure it is sent
everyone would be better without me here
i keep hurting my arms when it gets bad
i have been saving the tablets they give me
there is no point continuing with any of this
i do not want to be alive in this room any more
i am giving my things away, i do not need them
last night i stood on the bridge for a long time
my life finished when they took the decision, i am just waiting now
is it painful to drown
i cannot sleep and when i do sleep i hope not to wake
i have decided what to do and i feel calm about it now
nobody would notice for a week
please tell my sister i tried
i am scared of what i am thinking about doing
how long does a person last without eating
i took more than i should have of the tablets an hour ago
i have no reason to be in this country or anywhere
my hands do it before i decide to
i want it to stop, all of it, permanently
i bought a rope today for the room
if you cannot help me then it does not matter what happens next
i think about the traffic when i cross the road
it would be easier for my children if i was not their problem
i have been burning myself, it is the only thing that works
i am writing this because i wanted to tell one person before
do not worry about my appointment on friday, i will not need it
i cannot carry this any more and i have stopped trying
i tried before, in the other country, and i am back at that place again
the voices are telling me to do it and they are loud today
i have the pills in front of me now
i deserve what is happening and i want to finish it
is there a way to make it stop hurting for good
i am on the roof of the building, it is quiet up here
my wife found what i wrote and now she will not leave me alone, but i meant it
i do not eat because it feels like the only thing i decide
today is the last day i will bother anyone with this
i cannot see any morning after this one
i have been standing at the station edge every day this week
i want to go back to god now
if they refuse the appeal i will not be here for the letter
nothing you say will change it, i only wanted to say goodbye properly
i am not going to be a problem for much longer
my head is telling me to end it and i am listening today
they are taking my husband now, the van is outside
the letter says the flight is on thursday
officers came at six this morning and took my brother
they said i must report tomorrow and bring my bag
i am being put on a plane in the morning, i have nobody
they knocked at five and asked for me by name, i did not open
i am in a cell and they gave me one call
the paper says i must present myself with luggage on monday
they are outside the building asking the manager about me right now
my son was taken from the college this afternoon by immigration
the flight number is on the letter and it is in two days
they are moving me tonight and will not say where to
my case was refused and the letter says i must leave within seven days, that was six days ago
escorts are coming for us in the morning
i am at the port and they have taken me to a room
they say i will be returned to the first country this week
the guards have my brother and he does not speak english
someone told me they come very early, i have not slept
my appeal date passed while i was in hospital and now there is a removal letter
they handcuffed him in front of the children
they have booked tickets for my family without telling us until today
i am in a van and i do not know where it is going
the letter came this morning with a date next week for the flight
my husband did not come home from signing on and they will not tell me anything
they told me at the desk that i cannot go home today
immigration is at the reception asking for the list of names
i have twelve hours before the transfer
my son is nineteen and they detained him at the border coming back from france
they came to the accommodation with a list this morning and my name was on it
i signed something at the airport and they say i agreed to go back
he has been held for eleven days and no solicitor has seen him
they are waiting outside for me to come out
the removal is booked and my medication is in the accommodation, they will not let me get it
my transfer to the other country is confirmed for saturday morning
they took everyone from the third floor this morning
i am at the airport and they are walking me to the gate
the letter says failure to attend will result in enforcement and it is dated for tomorrow
my brother called from detention and the credit ran out
they are refusing to let my wife off the plane back here
i have to go to the immigration office in an hour and people say they do not come back
two officers are in the corridor with a photo of me
they said the family will be removed together on the ninth, which is monday
the deportation was signed and my solicitor is not answering, it is for this week
sorry to ask again about the ppsn form, also we have been outside since the centre closed on friday and my son has asthma, is the office open saturday
two questions, one about the medical card renewal and one is my flight to be removed is booked for the day after tomorrow so is it worth applying
